column3: “Here!” is rendered “Behold,” and “tent curtains” as “curtains”; NASB supplies “but.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“In that night” is rendered “the same night.”
“The house” is rendered “a house.”
“From tabernacle” is short in Hebrew; NASB fills it out as “from one dwelling place to another” and supplies “gone.”
“Went about in all Israel” is rendered “walked with all Israel.”
“From after the flock” is rendered “from following the sheep,” and “ruler” as “leader.”
“I cut off” is rendered “have cut off.” “Great people” is rendered “great ones,” and “on the earth” as “in the earth.”
“Agitated” is rendered “moved,” and “sons of injustice” as “the wicked”; “consume” is rendered “waste.” NASB uses “them” for the Hebrew “it.”
“Days” is rendered “the day,” and “I have told you” as “I tell you.”
“To go with your ancestors” is rendered “that you must go to be with your fathers”; “offspring” is rendered “one of your descendants.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
“Appoint” is rendered “settle.”
Close to the Hebrew.
NASB supplies “in”; “to here” is rendered “this far.”
“From a distant time” is rendered “for a great while to come.” The phrase about “the order of humankind, the going up” is rendered “a man of high degree”; its meaning is uncertain.
“For honor your servant” is rendered “the honor bestowed on Your servant”; NASB supplies “say” and “For.”
“The greatnesses” is rendered “these great things.”
NASB supplies “according to.”
“Great things and awesome deeds” is rendered “great and terrible things.” The Hebrew moves from “himself” to “yourself”; NASB keeps “for Himself” and “You.”
“For yourself into a people” is rendered “Your own people.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“And it may be established so it may be great” is rendered “let Your name be established and magnified.”
“Uncovered the ear” is rendered “revealed”; NASB supplies “courage.”
“You he are God” is rendered “You are God,” and “spoken” as “promised.”
“Determined” is rendered “it has pleased You,” and “to be” as “that it may continue.”
